text: For service contracts (except construction), the contractor shall not pay more than 50% of the amount paid by the government to firms that are not certified SDVOSBs or VOSBs listed in the SBA certification database. Subcontracted work from similarly situated SDVOSB/VOSB subcontractors counts toward this 50% limit. Other direct costs may be excluded if they are not the principal purpose of the acquisition and small business concerns do not provide the service per 13 CFR 125.6.

citations.quote: (a) Pursuant to 38 U.S.C. 8127(l)(2), the offeror certifies that—

[X] Services. In the case of a contract for services (except construction), the contractor will not pay 
more than 50% of the amount paid by the government to it to firms that are not certified SDVOSBs listed 
in the SBA certification database as set forth in 852.219–73 or certified VOSBs listed in the SBA 
certification database as set forth in 852.219–74. Any work that a similarly situated certified 
SDVOSB/VOSB subcontractor further subcontracts will count towards the 50% subcontract amount that 
cannot be exceeded. Other direct costs may be excluded to the extent they are not the principal purpose of 
the acquisition and small business concerns do not provide the service as set forth in 13 CFR 125.6.
